task_description: Implement four growth features for RepGate: (1) Shareable Meal Cards for organic virality, (2) Referral System with 7-day fine waiver rewards, (3) Group Challenges with daily leaderboards, (4) Smart Push Notifications based on user behavior.
review_fixes: join-group TOCTOU race: Added DB trigger enforce_group_max_members on group_members BEFORE INSERT that atomically rejects when count >= max_members
apply-referral double-apply race: Added UNIQUE constraint on referrals(referee_id) and graceful handling of 23505 error code in Edge Function
Gallery save scoped storage: Replaced direct filesystem write with Share.shareXFiles which works on Android 10+ without MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
Max groups per user: Added check in join-group limiting users to 5 groups
Duplicate share navigation: Consolidated _offerShareCard and _navigateToSharePreview into single _pushSharePreview method
review_v2_fixes: enforce_group_max_members trigger race: Added pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(new.group_id::text)) at the top of the trigger to serialize concurrent inserts per group
referral-redirect script injection: Added /^[A-Z0-9]{4,10}$/i validation before any interpolation, returning 400 for invalid codes
saveToGallery UX misleading: Removed duplicate Save button, consolidated into single Share button since both opened the system share sheet

verification.summary: No Flutter CLI or Deno runtime available in sandbox. All structural verification passed: balanced braces/parens/brackets in all Dart and TS files, balanced dollar-quotes in SQL migrations. Review fixes verified structurally.
